title: COVID-19 Extraction-Free Direct One-Step Fast Cycling Protocol
author: steve.puts
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bkjpkumn
materials: Cover the sample with 1 µL, mineral oil
Pre-mix the reagents for 81 wells 81 µL, total volume 40.5 µL, Direct reaction mix 3.25 µL, Enzyme mix 8.25 µL, Primers and probes mix 29 µL, PCR grade water

steps.title: Prepare Sample Extract
steps.instruction: Extract sample from the swab brush using PCR-grade water and PBS.

substeps.instruction: Place the swab brush into a 1.5ml microcentrifuge tube containing 135 µL PCR-grade water and 15 µL PBS (10x conc).
Squeeze the brush and remove it from the tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge Sample
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 12000 x g for 3 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Perform Lysis
steps.instruction: Treat the sample with Extraction Buffer to release RNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 4.5 µL PCR-grade water and 0.5 µL Extraction Buffer.
Incubate for 3 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Transfer Sample to Plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the processed sample to the well plate.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 0.25 µL of sample to the well plate.
Pipette up/down to ensure the sample has fully released from the pipette.

steps.title: Run Fast Cycling PCR
steps.instruction: Load the plate into the cycler and run with specified parameters.

substeps.instruction: Load the well plate into the cycler and move the chamber door down.
Run with the following parameters: RT 50C for 3 min; Denaturation 95C for 0s (maximum speed); Annealing 60C for 0s (maximum speed).

steps.title: Add Mix to Plate
steps.instruction: Pipette the mix onto the 81 well plate, optionally using a pipetting robot for speed.
